fact: The UNECA digital trade profile states that no legal regime in Eritrea deals with the general flow of data and that no conditions are made for the flow of data; the document gives no date for the statement, so its published date of 2022-01-01 is used.
Levellers, in a legal-status page last reviewed 8 June 2026, states that Eritrea has no data protection legislation and no restriction on cross-border transfer of data in its law.
